title: One person on both sides shows one Labor, Parts row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • {Location-A}'s Shop Supplies Charge is 0%, and nothing else is invoiced at {Location-A} today.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour and one part sold at $50.00; "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both read {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Invoice {Work-order-1}.
  2. Open Reports > Sales By Representative, set the date range to today, turn Show Unassigned on and turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  3. Read {Sales-rep-A}'s rows for the invoice.
  4. Set the Sales Type filter to Labor only.
  5. Set the Sales Type filter to Parts only.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice is created.
  • Step 2: the report shows today's invoices.
  • Step 3: one row, Sales Type "Labor, Parts", with the sum of both sides: Labor Invoiced $200.00 and Parts Invoiced $50.00; the invoice counts once.
  • Step 4: only a "Labor" row shows, with $200.00 of labor.
  • Step 5: only a "Parts" row shows, with $50.00 of parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R10: “When one person, or Unassigned, holds both the Labor and the Parts side of a work order and the Sales Type filter includes both, the two show as one row whose Sales Type reads "Labor, Parts" and whose figures are the sum of both sides.”
  • S5-R12: “With the Sales Type filter narrowed to Labor or to Parts, only that side's row shows (Story 8).”
  • S5-R13: “A representative counts an invoice once, even when they have two rows for it. When two people split an invoice, each counts it once, so the representatives' invoice counts can add up to more than the shop's.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
